situation: I see a flyer for a workshop on something I know nothing about
behavior: I sign up just to find out what it's like

situation: A friend recommends a strange-sounding restaurant
behavior: I want to try it that same week

situation: I encounter an idea that contradicts what I usually think
behavior: I sit with it and try to understand why someone would believe it
I look for places I've never even heard of

situation: I have free time and no plans
behavior: I read, sketch, or tinker with something just to see what comes of it

situation: I'm watching a film I expected to dislike
behavior: I try to find what's interesting about it instead of dismissing it

situation: I overhear strangers discussing a topic I know nothing about
behavior: I lean in and listen, sometimes ask what they mean

situation: I have to choose what to read next
behavior: I deliberately pick something outside my usual genres

situation: I learn a small new fact about how something works
behavior: I keep pulling on the thread until I understand the whole system

situation: Someone proposes an unconventional approach to a problem
behavior: I get excited and want to try it before sticking with the standard way
